findings.description: User-controlled N directly drives memory and CPU usage; no upper bound or sanity checks.
User-controlled N directly drives memory and CPU usage; no upper bound or sanity checks.
Calculations like N * sizeof(T) and N * N can overflow size_t, causing allocations to be too small and subsequent writes to overflow.
